notes: The ὄντες unit is the one awkward head: the ASV leaves the copula unwritten and only the supplied when and they answer to it, so the head falls on they for want of any other member. The privative ἀσύμφωνοι keeps agreed not, headed on the word glossing the stem.
after that is one clause-introducer and is not split (rule 61's warning).
s012 ὅτι is recitative, marked by punctuation and not by a word (rule 43); s016 is the second attributive article of τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, which rule 23 names in terms.
